== request-proxy
ENTRYPOINT=[/app/.venv/bin/request_proxy] CMD=[--host 0.0.0.0] WORKDIR= USER=1001
== ki-validierung
ENTRYPOINT=[] CMD=[python bmds_ki_validierung/foo.py] WORKDIR=/app USER=appuser

observation.command: for img in dokumentenpruefung fristenmanagement request-proxy ki-validierung demospipes-base-api; do echo "== $img"; docker image inspect --format 'ENTRYPOINT={{.Config.Entrypoint}} CMD={{.Config.Cmd}} WORKDIR={{.Config.WorkingDir}} USER={{.Config.User}}' $img:latest; done
